facts.anchor: Meg was right there at the shop door when I leaned in to hand her the coffee I’d bought for her.
facts.fact: Zak 把咖啡送到店门口，Meg 正好开门——两人第一次相对无言地笑。

facts.anchor: “Thank you.” She dipped her chin, wearing a pleased little smile that seemed to say she was thanking me for more than just the caffeine.
facts.fact: 他看着她「像喝多了又像嗑嗨」（tipsy and stoned），Zara 第三次用「be careful, Meg」踩刹车。

facts.anchor: “Anytime.” Oh, I felt smooth. Physically. Like all my sharp edges had been sanded off.
facts.fact: 他掏出从店里顺来的 Penthouse 页当书签，说「I might have to borrow this」——Meg 回敬「我们本可以办张借书证」。

facts.anchor: Considering the amount of time I’d been spending with my toys lately, I should feel like this all the time, but messing with them only took my mind off things for the seven minutes between s
facts.fact: 两人的第一次接吻：他把她按在收银台边、她拽住他领口。

facts.anchor: Not today. I felt properly stoned. That had been really hot, thinking of her pushing her fingers into her—
facts.fact: 她提醒「这是我们的初吻」，他纠正「之前还有一次」（在车里）。

facts.anchor: “What? Where?” I dragged my gaze up from the fit of Meg’s jeans.
facts.fact: 他们讨论「定义」：他愿意称之为「something」，她坚持要有名字——他笑。

facts.anchor: “Your shop. I wasn’t fast enough to say hi. She was moving like she was on a mission.”
facts.fact: Zara 第三次提醒 Meg「这是长跑」——她承认是，并把 Zak 称为「救世主」。

facts.anchor: Ah, shit. How had I missed seeing her? I always kept an eye on the store from across the street. But I’d been thinking about Meg.
facts.fact: 章末她对他笑，他也在笑，笑意里有一点「被我抓住了」的得意。
